title: Dark Matter Admixed Quark Stars: A Relativistic Two-Fluid Approach
summary: In this paper, we examine the stellar properties of quark stars containing dark matter, focusing on both non-rotating and slowly rotating configurations. By employing a two-fluid framework, we formulate the generalized Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations, treating dark matter and ordinary matter as independent perfect fluids that interact solely through gravitational forces. We model ordinary matter using the color-flavor-locked and the MIT bag model equation of state, while for dark matter, we apply a self-interacting bosonic condensate along with fermionic equation of state.
